rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM head h JOIN management m ON h.head_ID = m.head_ID WHERE h.age > 56;

SELECT d.creation, d.name, d.budget_in_billions FROM department d ORDER BY d.creation NULLS LAST;
SELECT MAX(d.budget_in_billions) AS max_budget, MIN(d.budget_in_billions) AS min_budget FROM department d;

SELECT h.name FROM head h WHERE h.born_state != 'California';

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.creation::DATE) AS creation_year FROM department d JOIN management m ON d.department_id = m.department_id JOIN head h ON m.head_id = h.head_id WHERE h.born_state = 'Alabama' GROUP BY creation_year ORDER BY creation_year NULLS LAST;
SELECT h.born_state FROM head h GROUP BY h.born_state HAVING COUNT(h.head_ID) >= 3;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM to_date(d.creation, 'YYYY')) AS year_of_creation, COUNT(*) AS number_of_departments FROM department d GROUP BY year_of_creation ORDER BY year_of_creation DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT d.name, d.num_employees FROM department d JOIN management m ON d.department_id = m.department_id JOIN head h ON m.head_id = h.head_id WHERE m.temporary_acting = 'yes';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM management m WHERE m.temporary_acting IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.department_id) AS num_departments FROM department d JOIN management m ON d.department_id = m.department_id LEFT JOIN head h ON m.head_id = h.head_id WHERE h.name IS NULL;
SELECT DISTINCT h.age FROM head h JOIN management m ON h.head_ID = m.head_ID;

SELECT h1.born_state AS state_of_birth_for_treasury_secretary, h2.born_state AS state_of_birth_for_homeland_security_secretary FROM head h1 JOIN management m1 ON h1.head_ID = m1.head_ID JOIN head h2 ON m1.department_ID = h2.head_ID WHERE h1.born_state = h2.born_state;

SELECT d.department_id, d.name, COUNT(h.head_id) AS num_heads FROM department d JOIN management m ON d.department_id = m.department_id JOIN head h ON m.head_id = h.head_id GROUP BY d.department_id, d.name HAVING COUNT(h.head_id) > 1 ORDER BY num_heads DESC NULLS LAST;
SELECT h.head_ID, h.name FROM head h WHERE h.name ilike '%ha%';

SELECT c.status FROM city c JOIN (SELECT f.host_city_id, COUNT(*) AS num_competitions FROM farm_competition f GROUP BY f.host_city_id ORDER BY num_competitions DESC LIMIT 1) AS mc ON c.city_id = mc.host_city_id;
